outcome: Infant hair tenofovir concentrations at delivery
cohort: 103 mother-infant pairs where the mothers were living with HIV and receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate-based treatment
finding: Hair tenofovir levels at delivery showed high cumulative transfer of tenofovir from mothers receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate-based treatment to their infants.
mod_finding: Tenofovir transfer was 42% lower from mothers who had cesarean compared with vaginal deliveries.
